name: e2b-cloud
notes: The hosted service. Network round trip and region are inside every number here; run the driver in the same region and record which.
Private memory is not readable on a service. The resident probe reports a proxy instead and must never be called memory per sandbox.
Only create is measured. E2B executes commands over gRPC against the sandbox's own envd, so a turn probe would use a different client than every other subject's and would not be the same measurement.

create.definition: sandbox create call until it will accept an exec, from a client in the same region

cost.definition: published price per vCPU-hour, idle and active
